title: When the Visitor Wakes
author: Felix Lockridge
blurb: Wren Marchetti, a pest controller called to something with fingerprints, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. Then the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must learn the song's last verse without singing along, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
